Defines the abstract class ILogBuffer with method(s). Provides an interface for log buffer during early stages of logging.

class ats_utilities.logger.buffer.ibuffer.ILogBuffer(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol, Generic

Defines the abstract class ILogBuffer with method(s). Provides an interface for log buffer during early stages of logging.

It defines:

methods:
add - Adds a message to the buffer.
flush - Flushes buffered messages to a writer.
clear - Clears the buffer.
is_enabled - Checks if buffering is enabled.
__str__ - Returns the buffer as a string representation.

  • message – The message to buffer.

Clears the buffer.

flush(writer: Callable[[LevelType, MessageType], None]) → None[source]¶

Flushes buffered messages to a writer.

Parameters:

writer – The logging method used to write buffered logs.

property is_enabled: bool¶

Checks if buffering is enabled.

Returns:

True if buffering is enabled, otherwise False.
